name: Zhutkie istorii Ezarelja na Hellouin
source: Annual Halloween always touches souls and hearts of all residents of Eldarya. But only a few know what this feast hides. This secret may only be revealed by the wise leader of one of the Guards. Truth or fiction? What awaits main heroine in her pursuit of truth?
translation: 每年的万圣节都会触动埃尔达利亚所有居民的灵魂与心灵。但只有少数人知道这个节日隐藏着什么。这个秘密只有某支守卫队的睿智领袖才能揭示。真相还是虚构？女主角在追寻真相的过程中将面对什么？
